name: cloud-vault
description: Diego's Cloud Vault — standalone Vaultwarden client Android app. Hosts vault.diegonmarcos.com (self-hosted Vaultwarden) in a dedicated BrowserHostFragment APK with the constellation updater. Extracted from Cloud SuperApp's vault section (libs:vault was a KeePassDX stub) in favour of the full Vaultwarden web-app experience. Build via Nix devShell, one APK out.

vault._doc: Bitwarden-fork rebuild of this app, REPLACING the WebView wrapper above (once CI proves it builds — build.sh's default `build`/`release` still target the WebView app; this fork is only reachable via `./build.sh materialize-fork vault` / `build-fork vault`). Uses the SAME fork machinery ea_cloud-mail's forks.mail entry uses (see cloud-mail-fork-engine.sh, ported verbatim into this app's build.sh).
vault.label: Cloud Vault (Bitwarden)

build._doc: Module `app` (applicationId com.x8bit.bitwarden upstream, com.diegonmarcos.cloudvault after patch 0001) is the password manager — NOT `authenticator`, a different product in the same repo. Flavor `fdroid` (dimension `mode`) is the Google-free flavor: Firebase/Crashlytics/ML-Kit/Play-Billing are standardImplementation-only and GoogleServices/Crashlytics tasks are disabled for fdroid in afterEvaluate. No release signingConfig is declared upstream (app/build.gradle.kts release buildType has none) so the APK comes out unsigned from gradle; build-fork's unconditional _enforce_signature re-signs it with the ONE shared constellation key regardless — no 'signing' key needed here.
build._build_blocker_doc: com.bitwarden:sdk-android is resolved from https://maven.pkg.github.com/bitwarden/sdk (settings.gradle.kts dependencyResolutionManagement), which 401s without an authenticated GitHub account/token even for public artifacts — verified un-buildable in this sandbox. settings.gradle.kts reads the credential as: password = userProperties["gitHubToken"] (rootDir/user.properties, gitignored, local-dev only) ?: System.getenv("GITHUB_TOKEN") ; username is hardcoded to "" (empty). CI MUST export GITHUB_TOKEN from a secret named BITWARDEN_PACKAGES_TOKEN (a PAT/fine-grained token with read:packages on bitwarden/sdk — the default GITHUB_TOKEN this repo's own Actions runner mints is scoped to diegonmarcos/cloud-unix only and CANNOT read a different owner's GitHub Packages) before invoking `build.sh build-fork vault`. Do not set gradle_props here for this — it's a plain env var the upstream settings.gradle.kts already reads, not a project property.

vault.comment: Bitwarden Android (password manager). Rebrand + self-hosted-server-default + NOTICE patches in ea_cloud-vault/patches/. materialize-fork works today (pure git clone+patch, no network auth needed); build-fork is UNVERIFIED end-to-end because of the maven.pkg.github.com 401 above — the first CI run with BITWARDEN_PACKAGES_TOKEN set is the real test.

signing._doc: ONE shared Cloud-constellation signing key for ALL Android apps (Cloud-Comms hub+forks, Cloud-Nav, Cloud-Wallet, Cloud-Browser, Cloud-Vault, Cloud-IDE, Cloud-SuperApp). The SAME key signs every app so cross-app signature-IPC + the in-app fleet updater never hit a signature mismatch. KEY LOCATION (raw credential + sops passwords live ONLY in the vault repo): A0_keys/providers/android/release.jks (OU=Cloud Constellation) + A0_keys/providers/android/signing.secrets.yaml. build.sh::_resolve_signing resolves $VAULT_DIR (default ~/git/cloud-vault) + sops-decrypts the passwords, exporting ANDROID_KEYSTORE_FILE/ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD/ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS/ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD which the gradle signingConfig reads. CI does the same via a vault checkout + the SOPS_AGE_KEY secret. THERE IS NO FALLBACK: if the key is unavailable the build FAILS LOUD.

diagnostics._doc: On-device DevControlServer diagnostics → cloud sink. Baked into BuildConfig.LOG_SINK_URL / LOG_SINK_STREAM by app/build.gradle. Empty url = cloud push disabled.

toolchain._doc: Pinned for reproducibility — all derived in flake.nix. Bump here, rebuild devShell.

modules._doc: Single source of truth for the Gradle module graph. settings.gradle iterates this list.
